passages.title: A Simple Morning Routine
passages.body: I wake up early and keep a quiet morning routine. First I stretch for a few minutes. Then I open my notebook and review five words. Small steps still mean progress. After that I make coffee and plan the day.

passages.title: On the Subway
passages.body: The subway is crowded in the morning. I wear headphones and listen to a short podcast. At the next station I transfer to another line. The ride takes twenty minutes. When I arrive I feel ready for work.

passages.title: Weekend at a Cafe
passages.body: On the weekend I meet a friend at a small cafe. We order a latte and sit at a table by the window. Our conversation is slow and relaxed. Sometimes we go to the library later to borrow a book from the shelf and return another one.

passages.title: Streamlining Our Workflow
passages.body: Our team decided to streamline the approval process. We used to negotiate every detail by email, but now we give quick feedback in a shared document. We implemented the new workflow last month, and everyone says it is more convenient than before. We also cancelled a subscription we no longer needed. Small changes like these make a big difference.
